[[File:Flight_School.jpg|thumb|320px|Flight school cadets learning advanced techniques]]
'''Flight school''' was the name of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] system for training [[TIE pilot]]s. It was not a part of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], however. Instead, the Navy's best junior officers would transfer to flight school after they left the Academy system.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> 

==Organization==
===Enrolment===
Only the top five percent of Navy cadets could enter flight school, although at the central [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]], this eligibility was extended to the top third.<ref name="ISB" /> These restrictions reflected the demanding nature of pilot training, and flight school itself had a 90% failure rate,<ref name="Databank">[[Databank (original)]] on [http://www.starwars.com/databank/organization/tiefighterpilots/?id=eu TIE fighter pilots]</ref> but with such strict measures in place, the Academy system alone could not provide enough pilots for the Empire.<ref name="ISB" />

As a result, additional flight school candidates included serving officers with proven potential,<ref name="SWSB">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> and skilled flyers from outside the Navy.<ref name="ISB" /> The former group included men like [[T. Alvak]], who had previously flown with a Navy [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] unit for two years,<ref name="SWSB" /> while the most famous example of the non-military intake was perhaps [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who was put through flight school after just a two-month basic-training course.<ref name="TSC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>

===Curriculum===
Flight school emphasized a hands-on approach, putting the young officers behind the controls of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] in a [[training squadron]] from about half way through their course. Although this was not a front-line unit, it was normally part of a front-line [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]], so that cadets would fly under combat conditions even during their training.<ref name="ISB" /> Reflecting this, many flight schools were located aboard [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The [[TIE training school|Tir training school]] was on the ''[[Inflexible]]'',<ref name="SWSB" /> while the training squadron aboard the [[Victorious (capital ship)|''Victorious'']], the flagship of the [[Qeimet fleet]], also provided new pilots for the [[Scimitar assault wing]].<ref name="ISB" /> The [[Vengeance II|''Vengeance'']] also appears to have operated a flight school under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Trox (Imperial)|Trox]].<ref name="TSC" />

==Behind the scenes==
A number of prominent characters advance from the Imperial Academy system directly to front-line postings as TIE pilots, including [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]] tour of duty with [[37th Imperial Fighter Wing|6/37th]] aboard the ''[[Abrogator]]'', and the service of [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] with [[Twilight Squadron (Imperial)|Twilight Squadron]] aboard the [[Rand Ecliptic/Legends|''Rand Ecliptic'']].
